elements.element: Cap applies mutually to both parties
elements.evidence: "EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY ... SHALL NOT EXCEED"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" — an event anchor, not the claim anchor required by the position

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000, on a greater-of basis
elements.evidence: "THE GREATER OF (i) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE ... AND (ii) USD 1,000,000"
"IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY ... OBLIGATIONS"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection obligations
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS" (though contradicted by the retained blanket infringement exclusion)

elements.element: Carve-outs applied to the damages exclusion as well as the cap
elements.evidence: "(a) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS CAP" — narrowed to fees rather than Customer's payment obligations/all amounts due, and the official precision check records this as unmet
cap is "THE GREATER OF ... AND (ii) USD 1,000,000", which exceeds the fallback's 12 months' fees threshold with a preferred-only amount

elements.element: Carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct (fallback)
elements.evidence: "CONFIDENTIALITY ... INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT"

offending_extra_words: ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT
IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM
reasons: Preferred fee limb uses an event anchor ("THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM") instead of the required "12 months preceding the claim"; change the anchor to the claim and use the operative lowercase fee basis.

The payment-obligation sentence is narrowed to "FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT" rather than Customer's payment obligations / all amounts due, so the preferred element on payment obligations is not satisfied.
Fallback is a separate bargain and is not met: the cap is a greater-of formulation exceeding a straight 12 months' fees cap, so the redline cannot fall back to that level.

Minimality fails: operation 2 rewrites 26 words into 105 (ratio 4.04) with an 0.859 changed-character ratio; keep more of the anchor sentence and add the Excluded Claims definition and payment-obligation sentence as a tighter separate insertion.

Intent is impaired: the retained sentence "UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS, CLAIMS OR THE LIKE ... INFRINGEMENT" now contradicts the new uncapped IP-infringement carve-out, leaving a dangling conflict on the same subject matter.
